'''Chiemi Ishimatsu''' (Japanese: '''石松千恵美''' ''Ishimatsu Chiemi'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Ishimatsu was born on May 5, 1976 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She started her work in the {{pkmn|animated series}} during the beginning of '{{aniseries|XY}}, voicing the [[Officer Jenny]]s of [[Kalos]]. Ishimatsu is currently affiliated with the talent agency Ken Production.
